verdict.gate: FAILED — high-confidence exact-match accuracy 56.1% (threshold 85%). Phase 2 NOT run.
verdict.diagnosis: Not a model failure: adjacency-tolerant high-conf accuracy is 84.1%. Misses are overlapping/synonym buckets, not wrong industries. (a) VOCABULARY OVERLAP: Trade Printers and Print Industry/Broker/Supplier are synonyms (8 of the misses); Advertising/Corporate/Creative and Retail/Luxury/Creative and Industrial/Corporate are fuzzy boundaries where the human label is one defensible choice among several. (b) THIN FEATURES: name+domain+8 generic capability buckets barely discriminate (almost everyone buys Flat Sheets/Design/Specialty). (c) INACTIVE TAIL UNVALIDATED: only 4 of the 1,912 trusted labels are inactive/name-only, so the Phase-2 majority (name-only Not Selected) cannot be validated against trusted labels and is the weakest case (1/4 correct in the tiny sample).
verdict.cost_note: Cost is NOT the constraint — phase1 was $0.0036, full phase2 would be ~$0.30-0.40. Accuracy is the constraint.

tuning_plan: 1. Fix the vocabulary FIRST: merge Trade Printers + Print Industry/Broker/Supplier into one bucket; either merge or sharply define Advertising vs Corporate vs Creative (the biggest confusion cluster). A cleaner ~10-bucket vocabulary should lift exact-match toward the 84% adjacency ceiling.
2. Enrich features: add website text / email-signature job-titles / ABN-industry lookup / actual product detail — the 8 capability buckets are too coarse to separate industries.
3. Few-shot anchor: include 2-3 Carbon8 labelled examples per (cleaned) bucket so the model matches their labelling convention, not its own.
4. Separate validation for the inactive/name-only tail (human spot-check a Phase-2 sample) since trusted labels cannot cover it.
5. Re-run the Phase-1 gate after (1)-(3); only proceed to Phase 2 at >=85% high-conf, and write back ONLY llm_high_conf until the inactive tail is human-checked.

writeback_schema_proposal.principle: Never overwrite qb_customers.industry (QB-synced source of truth). Write enrichment to a separate platform-owned table; application reads QB-if-usable else enrichment.
writeback_schema_proposal.ddl:
CREATE TABLE customer_industry_enrichment (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  customer_key_id text NOT NULL,           -- joins qb_customers.customer_key_id
  matched_company_id uuid,                 -- convenience link to customer_companies(id)
  predicted_industry text NOT NULL,        -- one of the fixed vocabulary (CHECK)
  industry_source text NOT NULL CHECK (industry_source IN ('llm_high_conf','llm_low_conf','llm_abstain')),
  confidence text,                         -- high|low
  provenance text,                         -- model reasoning
  signals_used text,                       -- name+domain+orders | name-only
  active_with_orders boolean,
  model text,                              -- e.g. gpt-4o-mini
  enriched_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (client_id, customer_key_id)
);
writeback_schema_proposal.read_logic: effective_industry = qb_customers.industry if usable (not Not Selected/blank/Small Business/Extinct) [source=qb, authoritative] ELSE customer_industry_enrichment.predicted_industry [source=industry_source]. Recommend surfacing only source IN (qb, llm_high_conf) in production until the inactive tail is human-validated.
writeback_schema_proposal.why: Survives QB re-syncs (qb_customers.industry untouched), provenance auditable per row, re-runnable (UNIQUE upsert), and keeps the 1,912 human labels authoritative.

verdict_3cause.evidence: strict high-conf 56.1% -> adjacency-tolerant 84.1% (+28pts); and the 19 real misses reveal MORE overlap buckets not yet collapsed (Healthcare/Education-vs-Government, Retail-vs-Creative, Property-vs-NFP) which would push adjacency-tolerant to ~90%. ~13/19 real disagreements are genuinely either-defensible.
verdict_3cause.classifier_error: SMALL: only ~4/112 non-abstained are clear classifier errors (Koala, Odd Culture, Maui Jim, Krama Yoga - over-indexed on a generic name token). Fixable with few-shot.
verdict_3cause.qb_label_noise: REAL: of 19 real disagreements, classifier is clearly right (QB wrong) on 2 (James Creative Agency, Studio Odea - both mislabelled Property) and defensible on ~13 more. So the 1,912 trusted labels carry a meaningful error/subjectivity rate (top-revenue spot-check missed it) -> true classifier accuracy is materially ABOVE 56%.
verdict_3cause.decision: VOCAB-COLLAPSE first (biggest lever) + GROUND-TRUTH-CLEANUP second (review/relabel QB errors; use defensible-match not exact-match as the gate metric). CLASSIFIER-TUNE is the smallest lever (few-shot for generic-name cases).
verdict_3cause.monday_path: The 116 active order-history-rich Not-Selected customers (what Monday needs) are only 116 and have richer features -> enrich with the classifier (high-conf) and HUMAN-spot-check all 116 (reviewable in <1hr). Do NOT block the Monday deliverable on solving the full 12,600 base or the inactive tail.
